text_block_list.text:
One night, a few days before Christmas, I 
received a LANE message from Marvelous 
Sunday—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: "Wh-What do I do, I can't move!"

I hurried to the designated spot and 
searched for Marvelous Sunday, when—
—TRAINERRRRRR!!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Trainer, Trainer, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: M—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Merry Marvelous, Trainer!☆★☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Merry Mave!★ Mave Merry!☆★ It's just so, 
so totally marvelous!★☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Look to the right, it's Marvelous☆★ To the 
left, it's Marvelous☆★ Everyone's smiling☆ 
Happy faces★ Marvelous☆★
choice_data_list: ...Could you explain the situation to me?

text_block_list.text:
After calming her down and listening, it 
turned out she was so overwhelmed by the 
city's aura of happiness that she was 
rooted to the spot.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Aaah, my whole body is just buzzing with 
energy☆ Because absolutely everything is 
just so marvelous★☆"
choice_data_list:
Well, as long as you're safe, that's all 
that matters.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm sorry, I didn't mean to worry 
you!! I just really wanted to show you 
too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Because Christmas was so amazing! ☆ The 
streets, the trees, and even the tower 
were sparkling! ★☆ Everyone's eyes were 
twinkling with excitement—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Wait wait wait, Trainer, could it be, or 
rather it definitely is!?!?!?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
If we deck out the races in sparkling 
illuminations like Christmas, couldn't we 
make them even MORE marvelous!?!?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, amazing, Christmas is 
amazingââ An illuminated raceâ 
Marveloooousâ ââ â

As I watch Marvelous Sunday frolic with 
her sudden whims with a wry smile—

text_block_list.name: Female Marvelous Fan
text_block_list.text: —Ah, umm...
choice_data_list: Yes! What can I do for you?

text_block_list.name: Female Marvelous Fan
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, I knew it!! You're Marvelous 
Sunday-chan, aren't you!?!? I'm such a 
huge fan!!! I love you so much!!!

text_block_list.name: Female Marvelous Fan
text_block_list.text:
I always watch your races!! You're always 
so cheerful and cute, but when you run, 
you're so powerful!!!
(Murmur... murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Marvelous Sunday!? I'm a fan too!! 
Good luck in the Arima!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... It's the real deal!! Could I get a 
picture with you?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Female Marvelous Fan
text_block_list.text:
Watching Marvelous Sunday-chan race makes 
me feel like even someone like me is 
allowed to be positive, and that's why—!!!

text_block_list.name: Passerby C
text_block_list.text:
Over here, hurry!!! I'm seriously telling 
you, Marvelous Sunday is here!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ohoooo??

text_block_list.name: Surrounding Fans
text_block_list.text:
Marvelouuus!! We're counting on you in the 
Arima! Do your best, Marvelous!!!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Howaaaaah!☆?★!☆?★

It looked like it was going to cause a 
massive scene, so I apologized to everyone 
around us and ran off to a quiet, deserted 
spot.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaha, ahahahaha☆★ That was a huuuuge 
surprise, wasn't it, Trainer☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous and marvelous squeezing tight 
together☆ We were thiiis close to a big 
bang★☆
choice_data_list:
I'm grateful for all that cheering, but 
still...

I'm grateful for all that cheering, but 
still...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Mm☆★☆★ Everyone had such marvelous looks 
on their faces☆ Marvelous enough to rival 
even Christmas★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: ——————Ah, right!☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I get it now! ☆★ You felt a spark 
because they were similar! ☆ It's the 
marvelous before the Marvelous! ★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That's right☆★ I was wondering about it 
all day today☆ So excited and restless★ 
Different, yet so totally Marvelous☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
How about you, Trainer!? Do you know 
anything similar!?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I have such, such high hopes for it, but 
mixed with just a tiny bit of anxiety☆ I 
want to take it out soon, but I still want 
to gaze at it too★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"The marvelous☆★ that was also shining on 
the faces of everyone walking around 
today!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see— It's a present that hasn't 
been opened yet☆★☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That pre-race flutter feels just like the 
excitement right before opening a present 
☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Maybe the waiting is the most fun part? 
But still, when I open it, I'm sure a very 
special Marvelous is waiting for me! ☆★☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I wanna open it right now, right now, 
right now☆★ But, but, I also wanna keep it 
just like this a little longer☆★

"I feel like I understand that sentiment. 
Ever since the press conference about 
running in the Arima Kinen the other day—"

—Ever since realizing Marvelous Sunday's 
dream would finally come true, I've been 
feeling restless with a similar emotion.

A present that has been sitting right in 
front of me all this time, still unopened—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
So you can look forward to it too, 
Trainer☆ I'm giving one to every, 
eveeeryone★☆ A very special, top-tier 
Marvelous—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
At Nakayama next time, I'll give Trainer 
some ☆★☆★ too!

Waiting until the coast was clear of 
onlookers, she finally made her way back 
near the academy—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaha☆ That was so fun★☆ I soaked up 
so, so much Marvelous★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Mm☆ I got to see the fans' faces, so my 
Marvelous Gauge is fully charged★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"If I run with this momentum, I know I can 
create a wonderful Marvelous that won't 
lose to any rival at the Arima Kinen!☆★"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Looking forward to it, Trainer☆★ It's 
almost time—almost time, at long last—!

A dream that had grown grander and 
grander. Its final chapter was now fast 
approaching—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ahhhhhh!!!! Oh no, I totally forgot!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I went all the way out shopping and didn't 
even get to buy it~~! After all that 
effort, too~~!
choice_data_list: So what were you planning to buy?
What were you planning to buy?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Christmas decorations, presents, and 
stuff! I wanted to have a party with you, 
Trainer!

I assumed you had plans to spend it with 
friends. To be honest, my mind was so 
consumed by racing that I had almost 
forgotten about Christmas myself—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Because, because, the Arima Kinen is a 
Marvelous we share with everyone, right?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
B-But Christmas with my Trainer is a whole 
different kind of marvelous, isn't it???

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I wanted to throw a super 
special party☆★ Lighting up the Trainer's 
Room with flashing lights, getting a 
10-tier cake, a giant slab of meat, and—"
choice_data_list: It was that big of a project?!

text_block_list.text:
To think you'd put so much thought into 
this, even with a major race right around 
the corner!

Feeling guilty for coming completely 
unprepared, I wondered if there was 
anything I could offer instead—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —Merry Marvelouuus☆★
(Phew...)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaay☆★ Cake, cake☆★ Trainer, let's split 
that flavor of yours too☆★

Sorry it's just stuff from the convenience 
store.

Sorry it's just stuff from the convenience 
store!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
No way☆ I'm super happy★☆ Trainer is here★ 
We have cake☆ And because it's Christmas, 
it's totally Marvelous★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Trainer! I wanna throw another 
party☆★ A marvelous one together with 
you☆★

Then next up is the post-race celebration, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That is absolutely, positively marvelous☆★ 
Cross your heart and promise, Trainer☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Next time, we'll go all-out marvelous with 
super shiny and dazzling decorations to 
celebrate, okay?!!!!

If that is Marvelous Sunday's wish, I 
resolved to make it come true no matter 
what.

Because I believe she will achieve the 
results befitting of that—
